meta_effective_dates_002.evidence: Effective July 1, 2013, the 2012-2013 Teachers’ Salary Schedule will be substituted and replaced with a new 2013-2014 Salary Schedule

meta_bargaining_unit_003.evidence: For those in the CTA bargaining unit, part-time is defined as those who work at least three and three quarters (3.75) hours, but less than six (6) hours per day.
